questions.question: For an acute angle in a right triangle, what is sine?
choices: Opposite leg divided by adjacent leg

questions.question: For an acute angle in a right triangle, what is cosine?
choices: Adjacent leg divided by opposite leg

questions.question: For an acute angle in a right triangle, what is tangent?
choices: Opposite leg divided by adjacent leg
Adjacent leg divided by opposite leg

questions.question: Which side of a right triangle is the hypotenuse?
choices: The side opposite the right angle
The side opposite every acute angle
Either side that forms the right angle

questions.question: For an acute angle whose opposite leg is 3 and hypotenuse is 5, what is its sine?
For an acute angle whose adjacent leg is 12 and hypotenuse is 13, what is its cosine?
What is sin 30°?
Why can the same leg be opposite one acute angle and adjacent to the other?
choices: The labels depend on the reference angle
Opposite and adjacent always mean the same side

tan A = tan B for every right triangle
